edit_guidance.preferred_tool: Prefer write_patch for file writes. Use op=create for new files, op=edit for small exact replacements, and op=replace only when rewriting the whole file is intentional.
edit_guidance.exact_edits: For op=edit or replace_range, first read the target file and make old_string match existing text exactly, including whitespace and indentation. Include enough surrounding context for one unique match.
edit_guidance.small_patches: Keep edit patches small and local. For moves, use one edit to remove the old location and one edit to insert the new location.
edit_guidance.retry: If an exact edit fails because the text is missing or ambiguous, re-read the file, choose a better unique old_string, and retry once before reporting the blocker.
